nodes.description: Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, ticket ownership, withdrawal recipients and admin gating.
Block timestamp used as lottery phase clock (nextDraw/nextPharse) and as an entropy input in drawing.
Administrator address allowed to call onlyAdmin functions and receive emergency withdrawals.
Boolean flag gating ticket purchases while a draw is in progress.
Current lottery round identifier; incremented on reset and used as mapping key.
Total token amount collected in the current round; part of the prize pool.
Count of distinct participating addresses in the round, used as entropy and accounting.
Timestamp of the last buy/reset, used to derive nextDraw and nextPharse.
Timestamp after which drawing() is permitted; derived from lastTimestamp + DrawDuration.
Timestamp after which enterDrawingPhase() is permitted; derived from nextDraw - ParseDuration.
Rolled-over unmatched prize balance bought back into the next round.
The four winning numbers of the current round, written by drawing() and cleared by reset().
Minimum ticket price enforced by buy/multiBuy; admin configurable.
Upper bound for ticket numbers and modulus for the pseudo-random draw.
Reward split percentages for first/second/third prize tiers; admin configurable.
External ERC20 token contract used for payments and prize payouts (untrusted external call target).
External LotteryNFT contract that mints tickets and stores claim status.
Per-issue array of total and per-tier matching amounts (pool accounting).
Per-issue per-number-key aggregated buy amounts used for reward math.
Mapping of user address to the token ids they purchased.
Per-token claim flag in LotteryNFT used to prevent double claims.
Ownership slot managed by LotteryOwnable/Ownable; gates onlyOwner functions.
Initializer configuring token addresses, prices, allocation, durations and owner.
Admin-only round reset: clears winning numbers, rolls remainBalance into a new ticket and advances issueIndex.
Opens the drawing phase when the parse window starts or the caller is the owner.
Draws four winning numbers from blockhash/gasleft/user input entropy and computes reward pools.
Internal ticket purchase used to roll over remainBalance into the new issue.
External ticket purchase: mints NFT, updates accounting and pulls ERC20 payment.
Batch ticket purchase looping over multiple number sets with a single token transfer.
Claims the reward for a single owned ticket and transfers tokens to the caller.
Claims rewards for multiple owned tickets and transfers the aggregate to the caller.
Derives the 11 lookup keys encoding combinations of the four ticket numbers.
Aggregates userBuyAmountSum buckets to derive per-tier matching amounts.
Returns the prize pool for an issue, guarding _issueIndex <= issueIndex.
Computes a ticket's reward from matching numbers and pool amounts.
Owner-only setter for the admin address.
Admin-only unrestricted withdrawal of tokens from the contract (emergency).
Admin-only withdrawal of balance exceeding the outstanding prize pool.
Admin-only setter for the minimum ticket price.
Admin-only setter for the maximum ticket number.
Admin-only setter for the three-tier reward allocation.
Owner-only transfer of contract ownership.
LotteryNFT owner-only minting of a new ticket with numbers, amount and issue index.
LotteryNFT owner-only flag setter marking a ticket as claimed.
LotteryNFT owner-only batch flag setter marking tickets as claimed.
ERC721 receiver hook invocation that calls back into the recipient contract.
ERC721 internal mint updating holder sets, owner map and emitting Transfer.
External ERC20 safeTransferFrom pulling user funds into the lottery.
External ERC20 safeTransfer pushing rewards or admin funds out of the lottery.
Inline assembly modulo/add derived pseudo-random number generation.
Use of blockhash(block.number-1) as a randomness source for the draw.
External callback into the receiver contract during NFT transfer.
Ticket price supplied by the buyer.
Four ticket numbers supplied by the buyer.
Per-ticket price used for every number set in the batch.
Array of four-number ticket sets for the batch purchase.
Ticket id whose reward is claimed.
Array of ticket ids claimed in one call.
Amount of tokens the admin withdraws.
Caller supplied entropy mixed into the draw hash.
New admin address.
Initial owner address passed to initOwner.
Newly minted ticket id in buy.
Accumulated price of the batch transferred to the contract.
Computed reward for a single ticket claim.
Aggregated reward across multiple claimed tickets.
Array of number combination keys generated for accounting.
Hashed value reduced by the assembly modulo to produce a winning number.
Previous block hash captured as an entropy seed.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines ticket owner, address registry entry and payer in buy.
msg.sender is ticket owner and payer for every set in the batch purchase.
claimReward requires msg.sender to equal lotteryNFT.ownerOf(tokenId) before paying out.
Every ticket in multiClaim is ownership checked against msg.sender.
adminWithdraw sends tokens to msg.sender after passing onlyAdmin.
adminWithdrawSafe sends the surplus to msg.sender after passing onlyAdmin.
setAdmin is gated by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender to _owner.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender.
reset is gated by onlyAdmin comparing msg.sender to adminAddress.
setMinPrice is gated by onlyOwner/onlyAdmin caller checks.
setAllocation is gated by onlyOwner/onlyAdmin caller checks.
enterDrawingPhase lets anyone call once block.timestamp >= nextPharse (owner bypass otherwise).
drawing is time gated on block.timestamp >= nextDraw and uses timestamp-derived data as entropy.
reset rewrites lastTimestamp = block.timestamp and derives nextDraw/nextPharse from it.
buy refreshes lastTimestamp and therefore shifts the time gates of the round.
multiBuy refreshes lastTimestamp on every iteration.
buy price parameter drives accounting and the ERC20 transfer amount.
buy numbers parameter is validated and stored in the ticket.
multiBuy price parameter drives per-ticket accounting.
multiBuy numbers array drives ticket creation and index keys.
claimReward token id selects the ticket being paid.
multiClaim ticket array drives the claim loop.
adminWithdraw amount is the transferred value.
Caller supplied noise is hashed into every pseudo-random number.
setAdmin writes the supplied address into adminAddress.
initialize forwards the provided owner to initOwner.
buy adds _price to totalAmount via SafeMath add.
buy increments totalAddresses the first time a user buys in the round.
buy sets lastTimestamp to the current block timestamp.
buy accumulates the price into userBuyAmountSum buckets.
buy appends the new token id to userInfo[msg.sender].
buy mints the ticket through the external lotteryNFT contract.
buy tags the new ticket with the current issueIndex.
multiBuy accumulates totalAmount per ticket.
multiBuy increments totalAddresses for first-time buyers.
multiBuy refreshes lastTimestamp inside the loop.
multiBuy accumulates price into userBuyAmountSum for each set.
multiBuy appends minted token ids to userInfo.
multiBuy mints tickets through the external lotteryNFT contract.
claimReward computes the payout through getRewardView.
claimReward reads the claim flag to block double claiming.
single claim delegating to the batch flag setter on the NFT contract.
claimReward performs an external ERC20 transfer to the caller.
multiClaim verifies each ticket is unclaimed before paying.
multiClaim computes each reward through getRewardView.
multiClaim marks every ticket claimed via multiClaimReward.
multiClaim performs an external ERC20 transfer of the aggregate reward.
adminWithdraw reads the atari token reference to transfer.
adminWithdraw transfers tokens out through the external token contract.
adminWithdraw is gated by onlyAdmin using adminAddress.
adminWithdrawSafe reads the atari balance and token reference.
adminWithdrawSafe subtracts the outstanding reward pool obtained from getTotalRewards.
adminWithdrawSafe performs an external ERC20 transfer.
adminWithdrawSafe is gated by onlyAdmin using adminAddress.
setAdmin overwrites the privileged adminAddress slot.
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender.
transferOwnership rewrites the _owner slot.
setMinPrice rewrites the price guard used by buy/multiBuy.
setMaxNumber rewrites the number bound and draw modulus.
setAllocation rewrites the reward split percentages.
initialize stores the token contract used for payments.
initialize stores the NFT contract used for tickets.
initialize sets the minimum ticket price.
initialize sets the maximum ticket number.
initialize sets the privileged admin address.
initialize seeds lastTimestamp from block.timestamp.
initialize seeds the reward allocation array.
initialize derives nextDraw from lastTimestamp + DrawDuration.
initialize derives nextPharse from nextDraw - ParseDuration.
reset rewrites the timestamp anchor from block.timestamp.
reset zeroes the participant counter.
reset zeroes totalAmount of the finished round.
reset clears the winning numbers array.
reset closes the drawing phase.
reset advances issueIndex by one.
reset spends remainBalance on a null ticket and zeroes it.
reset recomputes nextDraw from the new timestamp.
reset recomputes nextPharse from the new nextDraw.
reset calls internalBuy to roll the leftover balance into the next issue.
enterDrawingPhase flips the drawingPhase flag.
drawing writes the four winning numbers.
drawing stores the computed matching amounts and the nomatch ratio.
drawing scales the unmatched pool into remainBalance.
drawing closes the drawing phase.
drawing calls calculateMatchingRewardAmount for pool accounting.
drawing repeatedly calls getTotalRewards to burn gas and reads the pool.
drawing relies on assembly modulo arithmetic to derive predictable pseudo-random values.
drawing hashes blockhash(block.number-1) as its entropy source.
drawing uses the allocation percentages in the unmatched-pool formula.
internalBuy mints a ticket owned by the contract through lotteryNFT.
internalBuy adds the rolled-over price into totalAmount.
internalBuy refreshes lastTimestamp.
internalBuy calls newLotteryItem to mint the rollover ticket.
buy derives combination keys via generateNumberIndexKey.
buy mints the ticket through LotteryNFT.newLotteryItem.
buy performs an external ERC20 safeTransferFrom pull of user funds.
multiBuy derives combination keys for every ticket set.
multiBuy mints each ticket through LotteryNFT.newLotteryItem.
multiBuy performs a single external ERC20 safeTransferFrom of totalPrice.
calculateMatchingRewardAmount sums userBuyAmountSum buckets with SafeMath.
calculateMatchingRewardAmount returns totalAmount as the first array element.
calculateMatchingRewardAmount derives keys from the winning numbers.
calculateMatchingRewardAmount produces the per-tier amounts written into historyAmount.
getTotalRewards requires _issueIndex <= issueIndex before reading history.
getTotalRewards returns the live totalAmount for the current undrawn issue.
getTotalRewards returns historyAmount for already drawn issues.
getRewardView reads ticket numbers, amount and issue index from the NFT contract.
getRewardView reads the winning numbers of the ticket issue.
getRewardView indexes the allocation array by matching number.
getRewardView fetches the pool size through getTotalRewards.
newLotteryItem mints the ticket via the ERC721 _mint implementation.
claimReward on the NFT sets the per-token claim flag used as a double-claim guard.
multiClaimReward sets claim flags for many tokens in a loop.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, giving it control flow.
The ERC20 referenced by atari is the target of the external safeTransferFrom call.
The ERC20 referenced by atari is the target of the external safeTransfer payout.
buy stores the id of the freshly minted ticket.
multiBuy accumulates the batch price in totalPrice.
claimReward stores the computed reward before transferring.
multiClaim accumulates rewards across tickets.
buy holds the generated number index keys used for accounting.
drawing derives _randomNumber from the hash and gas observations.
drawing captures the previous block hash as entropy.
The single-ticket reward value is passed to the external token transfer.
The aggregated reward value is passed to the external token transfer.
The accumulated batch price is the value pulled from the buyer.
Generated number keys index the userBuyAmountSum buckets.
Each reduced random number is stored into winningNumbers.
The block hash seed feeds the assembly randomness computation.

normalization_plan.reason: The price parameter only has meaning inside the buy accounting and transfer logic.
The numbers parameter is validated and consumed only within buy.
The batch price parameter is only relevant to the multiBuy loop accounting.
The array of number sets is consumed only inside multiBuy.
The token id selects the ticket and is only meaningful for the claim action.
The ticket array only drives the multiClaim loop.
The amount parameter is directly the value passed to the token transfer.
The caller noise is only mixed into the draw hash inside drawing.
The new admin address is only used to overwrite adminAddress in setAdmin.
The owner argument is only forwarded to the ownership initialization inside initialize.
Local ticket id exists only as temporary state of buy.
The local totalPrice is the value handed to the external token pull.
The local reward is the value handed to the external token payout.
The aggregated reward is the value handed to the external token payout.
The key array is the direct output of generateNumberIndexKey used by buy.
The local random value is produced by the assembly modulo reduction.
The captured block hash only exists as the entropy seed of drawing.
